description: Kernel-mystery probe: Excel's small-x erf on very long runs (24,576 consecutive mantissas) at x = m/2048 bracketing the z where the fine factor's rounding rate changes (between 3.3E-4 and 6.2E-4; z = 2^-11 lies between the m = 45 and m = 46 runs). Runs: x0=0.01953125 z0=0.00038147 n=24576 row=1; x0=0.02099609375 z0=0.000440836 n=24576 row=24577; x0=0.02197265625 z0=0.000482798 n=24576 row=49153. B = ERF.PRECISE(x).
